summary: InTest Corporation filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to its existing credit agreement with M&T Bank. The Eighth Amendment extends the draw period for the term loan facility until August 28, 2028. No new borrowing amounts, financial terms, or material changes were disclosed. This is a routine credit facility amendment and does not constitute a special situation. The filing includes the amendment as an exhibit and incorporates details from prior agreements. There is no strategic event, transaction, or management change involved. Investors should monitor future filings for any material changes to the company's debt obligations or capital structure.
